articles.title: Implementing a breast proton therapy service: a practical framework and early clinical experience
articles.summary: This report outlines a practical implementation framework and initial clinical outcomes for a breast proton therapy service at the National Cancer Centre Singapore. The study highlights the specific challenges related to anatomical and setup uncertainties in breast proton therapy and provides a guide for centers developing similar services.

articles.title: An experimental imaging dose estimation method for the phase-II proton CT scanner
articles.summary: This study presents a reliable workflow for calculating imaging dose in a phase-II proton CT scanner. The findings show strong agreement with ion chamber measurements, supporting the use of this approach for image-guided and adaptive proton therapy.

articles.title: A Compact Eight-Parameter Analytical Model of Photon-Beam Lateral Dose Profiles
articles.summary: This research provides a compact analytical model to describe megavoltage photon-beam lateral dose profiles. The framework offers a standardized tool to support treatment planning system commissioning and quality assurance in radiation oncology departments.

articles.title: Cardiotoxicity of Anthracyclines and HER2-Targeted Therapies: Current Insights and Proposed AI-Assisted Cardio-Oncology Pathway
articles.summary: This review discusses the integration of AI models to predict cardiotoxicity in patients undergoing cancer therapies. It emphasizes that these tools should be used to complement, rather than replace, established clinical surveillance pathways in oncology.

articles.title: Tumor Semantic Modeling with Vascular Morphology Prior Correction Reduces False-Positive Malignant Predictions
articles.summary: A new framework for lung tumor classification integrates semantic modeling with vascular morphology analysis to improve diagnostic accuracy on contrast-enhanced CT. The model demonstrates potential in reducing false-positive results by incorporating clinical anatomical priors.

articles.title: Beyond Pattern Recognition Artificial Intelligence for Integrated Diagnosis of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
articles.summary: This review discusses the diagnostic complexity of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and the role of artificial intelligence in integrating multimodal evidence. It highlights how AI can improve diagnostic accuracy by synthesizing imaging, pathology, and molecular data.

articles.title: Predictors of radiation-induced lymphopenia in NSCLC: blood and bone marrow dose during chemoradiotherapy
articles.summary: This study identifies radiation dose to circulating blood as a significant predictor of lymphopenia in non-small cell lung cancer patients. It suggests that while correlations exist, strategies beyond simply optimizing dose to the blood are necessary for effective reduction of treatment-related lymphopenia.

articles.title: Combination Strategies for Carbon Ion Radiotherapy: Biological Rationale, Clinical Evidence, and Future Directions
articles.summary: This review explores the integration of carbon ion radiotherapy with other treatment modalities to improve therapeutic outcomes in radioresistant tumors. It summarizes the radiobiological advantages of high linear energy transfer particle therapy and current clinical evidence for its use in complex oncological cases.

articles.title: Cardio-immune crosstalk in novel radioimmunotherapy: implications for tumor immune remodeling, radiosensitization, and cardiac safety
articles.summary: This article discusses the impact of advanced radiotherapy techniques, including proton and carbon-ion therapy, on the tumor microenvironment and cardiac safety. It highlights how these modalities interact with immune pathways and the importance of considering cardiac outcomes in modern radioimmunotherapy.

articles.title: Evaluating a large language model for radiotherapy patient scheduling under realistic clinical and operational constraints: A feasibility study
articles.summary: A feasibility study demonstrates the potential for large language models to assist in the complex process of radiotherapy patient scheduling. The research indicates that human-in-the-loop AI tools can effectively translate clinical priorities into actionable, feasible schedules.

articles.title: Assessment of simulated respiratory gating based on external-to-internal motion prediction using a hybrid, adaptive deep-learning network
articles.summary: Researchers developed a hybrid deep-learning network to improve respiratory gating accuracy during radiotherapy. The model successfully mitigates errors associated with breathing irregularities, showing significant potential for enhancing precision in motion-managed treatment delivery.

articles.title: Radiotherapy for Unresectable Soft Tissue Sarcoma
articles.summary: This review discusses management strategies for unresectable soft tissue sarcoma, noting the limitations of conventional radiotherapy. It evaluates emerging techniques, including hypofractionated accelerated dose painting, aimed at increasing the biologically effective dose while preserving normal tissue.

articles.title: Proton beam therapy in the treatment of adenoid cystic carcinoma of the head and neck: a single enterprise retrospective cohort study
articles.summary: This retrospective study evaluates the clinical outcomes of curative-intent proton beam therapy for adenoid cystic carcinoma of the head and neck. Findings suggest favorable local control and manageable toxicity, though the authors emphasize the need for larger studies to compare definitive versus postoperative approaches.

articles.title: RadCalc 3D Monte-Carlo: tuning and independent dosimetric validation of radiotherapy treatment plans
articles.summary: This study details the implementation and validation of an independent Monte-Carlo based dose recalculation software for patient-specific quality assurance. The research provides a framework for integrating high-accuracy dose calculation verification into clinical linear accelerator workflows.

articles.title: Sensitivity in error detection of an electronic portal imaging device for patient-specific QA in head and neck VMAT plans
articles.summary: Researchers evaluated an electronic portal imaging device for patient-specific quality assurance in complex head and neck VMAT plans. The study utilized statistical process control to establish institutional tolerance limits, aiding in the detection of delivery errors.

articles.title: Progress in the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Radiotherapy: From Image Guidance to Adaptive Radiation Therapy
articles.summary: This review tracks the shift of artificial intelligence applications from image-guided radiotherapy toward real-time adaptive radiation therapy. The paper highlights AI's role in addressing operational inefficiencies and improving treatment personalization in clinical practice.
